title: Тост за вселенную и счёт за коньяк  (A Toast to the Universe and the Cognac Bill)

segments.t: Finishing his story in the office, Chef Barinov jokes to Lyova that swallowing the ring was not even a blunder—it was the universe itself trying to save Nagiyev from marrying Kristina. Out at the bar, meanwhile, Kostya hands Max the hefty bill for the expensive cognac they drank while swapping stories.
Я подумал.
Дело же не в нем.
Давай выпьем за нас.
За нас?
До дна.
Что это был косяк.
Потому что вся вселенная не хотела.
Чтобы хозяин женился на этой стерве.
А я сейчас серьезно говорю, между прочим.
Может быть.
Хозяин и не сделал бы ей предложение.
Вот ваш чек.
А вы знаете, сколько этот коньяк стоит?
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
Я подумал.
'I thought about it.' Kristina mentions that she thought about it so Barinov sees what is at stake.
Дело же не в нем.
'It is not really about the ring.' Claiming that it is not really about the ring sounds confident, even if Kristina has doubts.
Давай выпьем за нас.
'Let us drink to the two of us.' Once they should drink to the two of them, Kristina can finally tell Barinov what she means.
За нас?

'To the two of us?' Over the point and the work, Barinov presses Kristina for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
До дна.
'Bottoms up.' Around the work and room, Kristina sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
Что это был косяк.
'That it was a blunder at all.' Noting that that it was a blunder at all keeps Barinov's side of the story simple and clear.
Потому что вся вселенная не хотела.
'Because the entire universe did not want it.' Even though because the entire universe did not want it, Kristina keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Чтобы хозяин женился на этой стерве.
'For the owner to marry that shrew.' Between the work and the kitchen, Barinov gives Kristina a quick, grounded response.
А я сейчас серьезно говорю, между прочим.
'And I am speaking completely seriously right now, by the way.' Pointing out that she is speaking completely seriously right now by the way gives Barinov a sobering reality check.
Может быть.
'Perhaps.' Around the work and conversation, Barinov sets a calm, everyday tone with Kristina.
Хозяин и не сделал бы ей предложение.
'The owner never would have proposed to her.' Adding that the owner never would have proposed fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
Вот ваш чек.
'Here is your bill.' Barinov tells Kristina that here is Kristina's bill without dressing it up.
А вы знаете, сколько этот коньяк стоит?

'Do you have any idea how much this cognac costs?' By asking whether Barinov has any idea how much this cognac costs, Kristina presses Barinov for a straight answer. Even in the middle of the drama, she keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Я подумал.
Дело же не в нем.
Давай выпьем за нас.
За нас?
До дна.
Что это был косяк.
Потому что вся вселенная не хотела.
Чтобы хозяин женился на этой стерве.
А я сейчас серьезно говорю, между прочим.
Может быть.
Хозяин и не сделал бы ей предложение.
Вот ваш чек.
А вы знаете, сколько этот коньяк стоит?

That wraps up this scene as chef Barinov jokes to Lyova that the entire universe tried to stop Nagiyev from marrying Kristina, and in the dining room the bartender hands Max the bill for the expensive cognac he drank. See you next time!
Хорошего дня!
